g.text: All unique occupation–software pairs in each snapshot; not restricted to common occupation codes.
902 occupations present in both skill files; full occupation-level distributions are reported.
Repeat overlap analysis on normalized O*NET Commodity Title / Element Name categories to reduce vendor-name sensitivity.
Treat observed change as database-based renewal pressure, not a causal rate of human skill depreciation.
O*NET renamed Technology Skills to Software Skills in release 30.3; the longitudinal relation is documented by O*NET.
